implementation_strategy: Run the preregistered paired generate–validate–repair pipeline using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter. All LLM calls via the adapter's hosted-model API (no local models). Use identical intent→configuration prompt template for baseline and pipeline initial proposals (temperature=0, top_p=1.0). Baseline: one model call per task. Pipeline: one initial model call per task; if verifier fails, supply verifier counterexample to the repair-prompt and perform up to 3 bounded repair iterations (each an additional hosted-model call). Deterministic post-processing: whitespace/token normalization, grammar whitelist enforcement, parse to ACL/ACL-like AST. Run Relational NetKAT verifier inside a Docker CPU container invoked by the adapter for each parsed AST. All retries, request/response IDs, timestamps, and SHA-256 checksums logged in execution manifest. No human labour, external partners, or unavailable resources are used.
public_resources: Public intent→configuration corpus (RFC/vendor snippets + seeded synthetic topologies) — provenance hashes published
model_and_version_plan: Single hosted LLM via hosted_netops_gvr_v1 (exact runtime model identifier & provider metadata recorded per call).
Prompt settings fixed: temperature=0, top_p=1.0, deterministic max_tokens sufficient for config; same templates for baseline and pipeline initial generation.
Repair calls use same hosted-model API. Repair prompt includes verifier counterexample, property description, and explicit instruction; ≤3 repair iterations per task.
Deterministic canonicalization and syntactic parsing convert model text → ACL-like AST prior to verification.
Adapter logs request/response ids, response hashes, elapsed time; adapter automatic retry policy ≤2 per failed call.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic discovery: generate candidate intent→configuration tasks from seeded synthetic topology generators plus curated public RFC/vendor snippets with fixed RNG seed. Sequentially screen up to 400 candidates with automated verifier-encodability test; accept the first 200 encodable tasks as confirmatory paired set. Record SHA-256 checksums, selection seed, provenance for every candidate; report all exclusions with checksum and deterministic reason. No manual screening.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Canonical prompt templates for intent→configuration (baseline and pipeline initial) and repair (counterexample-anchored). Deterministic canonicalization pipeline: normalize whitespace/tokens, enforce grammar whitelist, parse into ACL-like AST. Automatic rejection: outputs that fail syntactic parse, include out-of-grammar tokens, or cause verifier runtime errors are rejected; such cases trigger repair prompts up to budget or deterministic exclusion per preregistration. Secondary semantic validation: deterministic packet-trace sandbox replay executed on 10% audit sample (Docker CPU).
execution_batches: Batch 0 — Discovery screening (deterministic): generate up to 400 candidate tasks; run automated encodability test (Relational NetKAT expressibility); record encodability verdicts and exclusions. (No hosted-model calls for screening.)

Batch 1 — Confirmatory paired runs (N=200): for each accepted task: (a) Baseline: 1 hosted-model call → canonicalize → parse → Relational NetKAT verify. (b) Pipeline: 1 hosted-model initial proposer call → canonicalize → parse → verify; if fail, run up to 3 repair iterations (each = 1 hosted-model call + canonicalize+parse+verify) until pass or budget exhausted. Record all outputs, ASTs, verifier logs, per-call latency and metadata. Expected model calls per task in recommended scenario: baseline=1, pipeline initial=1, average repairs=1.0.

Batch 2 — Audit sample (deterministic 10% seed-based sample of passing configurations): run secondary semantic validation (packet-trace sandbox) in Docker CPU on the 20 sampled tasks and automated failure-mode classification. Audit selection uses fixed RNG seed.
randomisation_plan: No randomized arm assignment (paired within-task design). All sampling, screening, and audit selections deterministic using published fixed RNG seeds. Any checksum collision with pre-lock artifacts triggers deterministic exclusion per contamination_plan.
caching_plan: Cache all model responses keyed by SHA-256 of (input+full prompt). Record cache hits in manifest. If adapter/provider returns identical byte-level outputs across distinct inputs, flag as potential provider-side caching and record for sensitivity analysis. Reuse cached verifier/AST results only when input+prompt checksum identical. Cached responses are used only for deterministic retries when input+prompt checksum matches; otherwise fresh hosted-model calls are executed and logged.
failure_recovery_plan: Deterministic automated retry policy: up to 2 automatic retries per failed model call (network/API). Parser or verifier runtime failures trigger repair-prompt retries under the per-task repair budget; unrecoverable syntactic or verifier runtime errors are logged and deterministically excluded per preregistered exclusion rules. Tasks with unresolved technical failures after retries are logged as 'technical_failure' and excluded from the confirmatory paired McNemar analysis but included in the technical-failure report. All recovery actions, timestamps, and reasons recorded in the execution manifest. No human adjudication.
result_schema: Per-task JSON record: {task_id, input_checksum, topology_seed, provenance:{source_id, source_checksum}, baseline:{model_call_ids[], output_text, canonicalized_text, parse_success(bool), AST|null, verifier_verdict:{pass|fail|error}, verifier_log, latency_ms, provider_metadata:{model_identifier, request_id}}, pipeline:{initial:{model_call_id, output_text, canonicalized_text, parse_success, AST|null, verifier_verdict, verifier_log, latency_ms, provider_metadata}, repairs:[{iteration:int, model_call_id, output_text, canonicalized_text, parse_success, AST|null, verifier_verdict, verifier_log, latency_ms, provider_metadata}]}, final_verdict:{pass|fail|timeout|technical_failure}, repair_iterations_used:int, end_to_end_latency_ms, contamination_flags:[], hashes:{input_prompt, outputs}, semantic_audit:{audited(bool), sandbox_results|null}, execution_notes:[] }
estimated_compute_notes: Recommended scenario (balanced): 200 confirmatory tasks × (1 baseline call + 1 pipeline initial call + 1 average repair call) = 600 hosted-model calls. Discovery screening performs CPU-only verifier-encodability tests (no model calls). Relational NetKAT verifier and packet-trace sandbox run in Docker on CPU. Adapter automatic retries (≤2) are logged; preregistered worst-case upper bound = 1000 model calls, well under maximum_planned_model_calls=10000. Wall-clock expected to finish within the 7-day limit; all timing metadata recorded.
